buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.description: Builds ships. Level 2 unlocks the Cruiser.

research.name: Weapons

ships.description: Reveals a planet’s resources and defenses.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Establishes a colony on an unclaimed planet.

ships.name: Cruiser
ships.description: Heavy ship for breaking through defenses.

reports.title: Welcome to Alien Colonies
reports.text: Develop your race’s colony, research and fleet. Before seeking Swarm Crystals, scout the hive’s defenses: it is a powerful fortress that rebuilds after defeat. You receive loot when your surviving fleet returns. The Swarm sometimes raids for ordinary resources; new players are protected for 24 hours. Ordinary crystals support your economy, while rare Swarm Crystals unlock skills in the wheel.

alien.name: Khar Swarm
alien.description: A few Swarm fortresses develop their economies and strong defenses. The Swarm can occupy up to 13 planets and occasionally raids players’ supplies. One crystal forms every 18 real-world hours, only in a defended nest; stock limit: 6. Scout the target and prepare for a costly expedition, preferably together with other players.

galaxies.name: Aurora
galaxies.description: The blue home galaxy. New empires begin here.

galaxies.name: Eclipse
galaxies.description: Golden dust lanes surround a dark core. A first destination for distant expansion.

galaxies.name: Nexus
galaxies.description: Violet arms and a bright core. New systems await your colonists.

galaxies.name: Omega
galaxies.description: A red spiral of stars. The expedition needs large fuel reserves.

galaxies.name: Zephyr
galaxies.description: A turquoise galaxy far from home. Plan a self-sufficient colony.

galaxies.name: Void
galaxies.description: A dark core at the edge of known space. The most distant expedition from Aurora.

nodes.name: Swarm Prism
nodes.description: Swarm Crystal loot limit per target +15%. Damage against the Swarm +6%. Limited by available stock and cargo capacity; rounded down.

nodes.name: Endless Factory
nodes.description: Building and ship production speed +14%. Energy output +8%.

nodes.name: Annihilation Battery
nodes.description: Attack power +8%. Damage against the Swarm +8%.

nodes.name: Eternal Rebirth
nodes.description: Surviving hull damage healed after each round +35%.

nodes.name: Heart of Rebirth
nodes.description: Building and ship production speed +12%. Energy output +8%.

nodes.name: Gatherer Antennae
nodes.description: Swarm Crystal loot limit per target +10%. Limited by available stock and cargo capacity; rounded down.

nodes.name: Colony Consciousness
nodes.description: Research speed +12%. Swarm Crystal loot limit per target +8%. Limited by available stock and cargo capacity; rounded down.

nodes.name: Crystal Echo
nodes.description: Swarm Crystal loot limit per target +4%. Limited by available stock and cargo capacity; rounded down.

races.name: Zetans
races.description: Green explorers who control gravity and emerald plasma. Smooth domes and silver discs form their colonies.
races.trait: First volley +35% damage. Crystal production +25%. Fast, lightweight discs.
races.tradeoff: Metal production −10%. Mines use more energy. Lighter hulls.

races.name: Symbionts
races.description: An organic civilization that grows living colonies and ships. Violet coral surrounds amber organs.
races.trait: Heals 35% of surviving hull damage after each round. Fuel production +20%.
races.tradeoff: Crystal production −15%. Ships take longer to grow and travel more slowly.

races.name: Automatons
races.description: Autonomous machines that build graphite fortresses and copper production lines. Their weapons accelerate metal to orbital speeds.
races.trait: Armor reduces all incoming damage by 12%. Metal production +25%.
races.tradeoff: Fuel production −20%. Heavy ships are slower and consume more fuel.

steps.title: Develop your colony
steps.description: Complete an upgrade to one of the basic buildings.

steps.title: Establish a second colony
steps.description: Send a colony ship to an unclaimed planet and wait for the colony to be established.

steps.title: Discover the Swarm
steps.description: Send a scout to the Swarm and read the report on its defenses.

steps.title: Get Swarm Crystals
steps.description: Prepare a powerful fleet, breach the nest’s defenses and bring back rare crystals. Coordinate raids with other players.

steps.title: Develop your race
steps.description: Buy your first skill. Each purchase raises the cost of the remaining nodes.

buildings.name: Gravity Extractor
buildings.description: Lifts deep ore using a gravity field. Racial metal production: −10%.

buildings.name: Crystal Resonator
buildings.description: Focuses crystals in levitating rings. Racial crystal production: +25%.

buildings.name: Ion Distiller
buildings.description: Separates fuel in silver ion chambers.

buildings.name: Singularity Core
buildings.description: Provides 100 energy per level, including skill bonuses. Energy powers resource production.

buildings.name: Antigravity Dock
buildings.description: Assembles discs and phase ships. Level 2 unlocks the Archon.

buildings.name: Psionic Observatory
buildings.description: Researches gravity propulsion and phase plasma.

buildings.name: Phase Matrix
buildings.description: Stabilizes the extraction field and reduces the energy use of mines and the distiller in this colony.

buildings.name: Echo Observatory
buildings.description: Reads system echoes. Scouting missions from this colony take less time.

buildings.name: Synapse Archive
buildings.description: Refunds some crystals when research is completed

buildings.name: Quantum Forge
buildings.description: Reduces construction time for all ships in this colony.

buildings.name: Phase Vault
buildings.description: Protects some of each ordinary resource from looting.

buildings.name: Gravity Nexus
buildings.description: Reduces fuel consumption for expeditions from this colony.

research.name: Antigravity
research.description: The entire fleet flies 20% faster per level. Stacks with propulsion and skills; speeds up new expeditions.

research.name: Phase Hulls
research.description: Increases all ships’ hull strength by 8% per level.

research.name: Coherent Plasma
research.description: Increases all ships’ attack by 8% per level.
research.reason: Requires: Psionic Observatory (level 4), Quantum Forge (level 2), Phase Plasma (level 2).

research.name: Folded Cargo Holds
research.description: Increases all ships’ cargo capacity by 12% per level.

research.name: Gravity Propulsion
research.description: Each level increases travel speed by 15% of the ship’s base speed.

research.name: Phase Plasma
research.description: Attack +15% per level. The Zetans’ first volley multiplies final attack by 1.35.

ships.name: Eye of Zeta
ships.description: Scout. Light scouting disc with gravity propulsion.

ships.name: Levitating Ark
ships.description: Transporter. Fast transport within an antigravity ring.

ships.name: World Seeder
ships.description: Colony Ship. Deploys silver domes for a new colony.

ships.name: Ray
ships.description: Light warship. Light ship armed with phase plasma; its first volley is 35% stronger.

ships.name: Archon
ships.description: Heavy warship. Silver command ship with a plasma ring.

ships.name: Flash
ships.description: Interceptor. Very fast assault disc for short raids. Its light hull requires caution.

ships.name: Eclipse
ships.description: Siege Ship. Slow siege ship. Attack +50% when assaulting a defended Swarm planet.
ships.reason: Requires: Antigravity Dock (level 6), Quantum Forge (level 3), Coherent Plasma (level 2).

ships.name: Horizon Ark
ships.description: Freighter. Large cargo hold for trade and transport. Requires an escort.
ships.reason: Requires: Antigravity Dock (level 4), Phase Vault (level 1), Folded Cargo Holds (level 1).
